body.p: Provided are an object selection method and apparatus. The method comprises: in response to a first operation acting on a graphical user interface, acquiring a detection region corresponding to the first operation (S301); acquiring at least one game interaction object which overlaps the detection region (S302); performing controlling to provide at least one selection control in a display region corresponding to the first operation, wherein each selection control corresponds to one game interaction object (S303); and in response to a selection operation acting on the at least one selection control, executing an interaction operation of the game interaction object corresponding to the selection control (S304). By means of acquiring a detection region corresponding to a first operation and by means of acquiring at least one game interaction object which overlaps the detection region, a selection control corresponding to each game interaction object can be provided in a display region, and the selection of a game interaction object is realized on the basis of the selection control, such that the selection of each game interaction object can be realized quickly and conveniently when a single-handed operation is implemented.
